title: App Hub
what: This app: all your apps in one place, with change requests.

title: Ticket Time Tracker
what: Time on work tickets, ticket statuses, notes and CSV export.

title: Bet Tracker
what: Bets, wins and losses across the season.

title: Quizzle
what: Hard daily quiz with fresh, fact-checked questions every day.

title: TV Shows
what: TV rewatch tracker with episodes, watch log and history.

title: Betbuilder
what: Premier League stats, match picks and a prediction tracker.

title: United Squad
what: Man United squad, transfers, managers and player stats.

title: Workout Roulette
what: Random HIIT and stretching sessions with a timer and log.

title: Fantasy Football
what: Auction-draft fantasy league with standings and stats.

title: Last Man Standing
what: Premier League last-player-standing game for the group.

title: Lads Night Out
what: Group ledger, pot tracker and Lotto log.

title: Match Predictor
what: Over 2.5 goals and both-teams-to-score chances, updated daily.

title: Daily Disciplines
what: Daily habits with streaks and XP, plus weight, calories and drinks.

title: Running Log
what: Running mileage, shoe rotation and race log.

title: The Ledger
what: Household bills, savings, credit card and calendar.

title: GTO Hand Review
what: Review poker hands against game-theory-optimal play.

title: Work Rota
what: Work hours by site, week by week (no longer used).
